options.name: JR Narita Express (N'EX)
options.notes: Reserved seats direct to Tokyo, Shinagawa, Shinjuku, Ikebukuro. Covered by JR Pass. Large-luggage racks included.

options.name: Keisei Skyliner
options.notes: Fastest to Nippori / Ueno (north-east Tokyo). Tourist combo with 24/48/72h Tokyo Subway Ticket is strong value.

options.name: Airport Limousine Bus
options.notes: Direct to most major hotels. Best option with lots of luggage or small children.

options.name: Fixed-fare taxi
options.notes: ~¥22,000-¥28,000 to central Tokyo. Only worth it for 3+ people with luggage.

options.name: Tokyo Monorail + JR
options.notes: To Hamamatsucho, transfer to JR Yamanote for anywhere on the loop. Covered by JR Pass via Monorail section.

options.name: Keikyu Airport Line
options.notes: Direct to Shinagawa and onward to central Tokyo. Fastest cheap option.

options.name: Airport Limousine Bus
options.notes: Drops at major hotels in Shinjuku, Asakusa, Roppongi, and Tokyo Station.

options.name: Fixed-fare taxi
options.notes: ¥6,000-¥9,000 depending on destination zone; late-night surcharge applies 22:00-05:00.

luggage_services.notes: ¥400-¥800/day by size. Large ones fill by 10:00 on weekends at Shinjuku, Shibuya, Tokyo Station.
Book via app — often the same price as a locker but guaranteed.
¥2,200-¥2,500 per suitcase. Drops at your hotel the same evening or next morning. Saves hauling bags on rush-hour trains.
Ask the bellhop to arrange — they handle the slip. 24h lead time.

atm_exchange.name: 7-Eleven (Seven Bank)
atm_exchange.notes: Most reliable foreign-card ATM in Japan. English menu. Inside most konbini.

atm_exchange.name: Japan Post Bank (Yucho)
atm_exchange.notes: Inside post offices and JP Bank branches. Accepts Visa, Mastercard, Amex, UnionPay.

atm_exchange.name: AEON Bank
atm_exchange.notes: Inside AEON malls and MaxValu supermarkets.

atm_exchange.name: Travelex (airports and major hotels)
atm_exchange.notes: Convenient but rates are 3-5% worse than ATMs. Useful only for small amounts on arrival.

atm_exchange.name: GPA / World Currency Shop (city)
atm_exchange.notes: Slightly better rates than airport counters.
